prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 39 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1385; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment kept growing well beyond what this injury usually needs, with more visits and new services added month after month.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear impact sustained while turning left at low speed, reporting neck and low back pain without loss of consciousness. The mechanism and force of the collision are consistent with the soft tissue strain described, and the patient has no known prior complaints involving these regions. Conservative care was initiated, comprising chiropractic manipulation, therapeutic exercise, and soft tissue work, delivered across 39 visits. Over time the plan expanded, with additional services added in successive months and visit frequency remaining high relative to what is typically expected for a strain of this type. Cervical and lumbar imaging was unremarkable, and physical examination findings are largely based on the patient's reported pain levels, with objective neurological and range-of-motion testing within normal limits. Billing review is ongoing for two similar charges recorded on the same date. Current recommendation is to taper care toward home exercise and reassess function at the next scheduled visit.
